description: Makes a destava.com link that sets this job search up to run every morning on the user's own Destava account, which brings them the new matches there. The user opens the link, signs in with Google and approves the search; nothing is set up until they do. Takes the query, location, remote and fresh_days of search_jobs. Nothing is stored for the link; our host's request logs keep network addresses for up to 7 days.

fresh_days.description: Only postings first seen in this many days. Default 7.

location.description: A city, region or country, e.g. "Seattle" or "Canada". Leave it out for anywhere.

query.description: What the user wants: a job title, skills, or both. Example: "senior product manager payments".

name: watch_search

say_to_user.description: Words the agent can pass on, with the link.

watch_url.description: The link for the user to open.

title: Watch a job search
